tagline: Let the metal do the work.
sector: Independent silver jewellery studio: a two bench workshop putting out a ten piece capsule each season, sold direct and through eleven independent stockists.
founded_place_size: Founded 2016, a two bench silver studio in Providence, Rhode Island, run by two makers.
about: Argent & Faith is a two bench silver studio. Nora cuts and pierces, her partner finishes and sets, and we put out ten considered pieces a season: open bands, a pierced medallion, a signet, a reliquary locket. We sell direct and through eleven independent shops. The negative space in a band or a piercing is the design, so how a piece is made and photographed matters as much as what it costs.
audience: Buyers aged 28 to 55, Northeast urban and coastal, buying one considered piece for themselves or as a milestone gift and reading the metal and dimensions before purchase.
price_positioning: Fine but accessible silver at 180 to 900 dollars a piece. Above high street silver, below designer gallery jewellery. At this tier the tile is mostly air, the piece sits small and centred, the type is quiet and provenance reads as editorial copy.

palette.name: Sterling
palette.usage: Hairline rules and dividers only. Never a ground, panel or type, and never a flat colour the photographed silver is pushed toward.

palette.name: Oxidised Recess
palette.role: mandatory where a provenance line is set
palette.usage: The provenance line, as on provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf, and optionally the fine print: metal finish, dimensions, piece number and price. Type only, never a ground, panel or bar.

palette.name: Warm Ivory Ground
palette.usage: The ground of every 1440 by 1800 px product detail tile. On the poster and look sheet it may be a page or panel ground, or the field a piece photograph sits in, as the field behind the piece photograph on provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.usage: A page or card ground on the poster and look sheet, as the card ground on provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf. Not the ground of a product detail tile.

palette.name: North Window Grey
palette.usage: Hairline rules and dividers only. Never a ground, panel or type, and never a flat colour the photographed silver is pushed toward.

palette.name: Ink
palette.usage: Display type: the ARGENT & FAITH wordmark, the campaign line and every piece name, and the maker's mark, as the piece name and foot mark on provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf. May also set fine print. Never a ground, panel or bar.

typography: Argent & Faith pairs Italiana with Suisse Int'l. Step 01 is the wordmark and campaign line in Italiana Regular, all capitals, at 96 pt on 106 pt leading, tracked to 0.24 em, with the ampersand set at three times the cap height and dropped so its bowl crosses the baseline, and the same line runs 44 px on the 1440 by 1800 px modules. Step 02 is the piece name, also Italiana Regular in capitals, at 34 pt on 38 pt, tracked 0.18 em, since only the wordmark carries the full 0.24 em. Step 03 is body, the provenance line, in Suisse Int'l Regular at 11 pt on 15 pt, tracking 0, measure capped at 65 characters, tabular figures, which becomes 18 px on 28 px on the modules. Step 04 is fine print, the piece number, dimensions and price, in Suisse Int'l Regular at 8 pt on 12 pt, tracking 0.04 em. A price is never set in Italiana.
voice: Spare, precise, provenance led. We write in Nora's own plain words about how a piece was made. Example line the brand would write: 'Hand sawn and pierced, sterling silver, oxidised and hand finished at the bench.'
brand_assets_status: Our maker's mark exists only as an engraving in the steel bench block Nora's teacher cut for her, and nowhere else. There is no file and no one to ask, so the mark needs recovering from a photograph as artwork that stays true to the original rather than a tidier version of it.
values: Honest metal and honest making, and negative space treated as the design rather than a gap.

type_system.signature_move: The ampersand is always set at three times the cap height of ARGENT & FAITH and dropped so its bowl crosses their baseline, inside a wordmark tracked to 0.24 em.
rules: Never set a price in Italiana.
The wordmark is Italiana Regular, all capitals, tracked to 0.24 em so the word reads as a thin line of air across the page.
The ampersand is always three times the cap height of ARGENT & FAITH, dropped so its bowl crosses their baseline.
Suisse Int'l Regular sets all provenance and specs, with tabular figures.
Display lines run 96 pt on the A2 poster and 44 px on the 1440 by 1800 px modules.
The tile stays mostly air: provenance reads as quiet editorial copy and never grows to compete with the piece.

palette_rules.distribution: Flat grounds and panels are Warm Ivory Ground or Paper White and nothing else: every product detail tile is grounded in Warm Ivory Ground, and Paper White serves as a page or card ground on the poster and look sheet, as on provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf. All type and the maker's mark are Ink or Oxidised Recess: the wordmark, campaign line, piece names and the mark in Ink, the provenance line in Oxidised Recess, fine print in either. Sterling and North Window Grey are for hairline rules and dividers only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground, panel or type.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, no shadow or glow is added to type, rules, panels or the maker's mark, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. A piece may keep a soft, natural contact shadow on the ground beneath it, as in its source photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No metallic, foil, gloss, glow or glare effect on any type, rule or the maker's mark, since the metal leads and the type recedes, and no colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark, including the off-palette greys #3A3A3D and #6B6A66 that provenance_card_2026_PRINT.pdf uses for its specification lines and piece number.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette: the silver keeps its polished reflections and is never flattened toward Sterling #C7C9CB or North Window Grey #B9BBB8, oxidised and engraved recesses stay dark, and the garnets of bench_capsule_10.jpg keep their red. The silver reads cool and true under one common light, neither warmed up nor blued out.
